simple.meaning: כַּרְמְלִי (Karmᵉlîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Karmelite or inhabitant of Karmel (the town).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כַּרְמְלִי (H3761) appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 30:5, with occurrences in 1 Samuel, 2 Samuel, 1 Chronicles.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כַּרְמְלִי (H3761) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כַּרְמְלִי (H3761) before moving outward to related references.
